visual.title: The conditioning event becomes the denominator
visual.caption: The tree splits the sample space by disease status, then by test result. A conditional probability restricts attention to one branch such as the positive result, so its denominator is the total probability of that branch, not the whole space.

predict.question: A person tests positive. Which quantity conditions on the test result?
predict.explain: P(D | +) restricts the sample space to the positive test results. The positive leaves form the denominator, and the disease-positive leaf is the numerator.
